resources.string:
Scale speedometer using an Android phone and two magnets

Based on a suggestion by Brendan Schyve

This is an app that uses the phone\'s magnetometer sensor to calculate scale speed.

Magnets

  • The two magnets should be \'similar\' in size and magnetic properties.
  • They should be placed a \'similar\' distance to the left/right \'edge\' of each carriage.
  • If too close the app may not recognise that the passing of the first magnet has ended.
  • Similarly, the carriage carrying the magnets should not be too close to the loco.

Screen

  • Scale - The model train scale to be used for the speed calculation.
  • Distance - Distance between the two magnets in centimeters, measured from leading edge to leading edge.
  • Threshold - The minimum amount above or below the ambient level which the app will register a magnet. Adjust to ignore background \'noise\'.
  • Axis - X, Y or Z. Which magnetometer sensor axis to use to measure the speed. Pick the axis that is giving the best responses.
  • Ignore first response - The magnets in the loco\'s motor are likely to trigger the sensor. This option allows you to ignore the first reading (the loco).
  • Restart (sec) - Time in seconds. If this is set at anything above zero, the values will automatically clear X seconds after the last successful reading. Note that This does not reset the ambient values.
  • Reset - Click this to clear both the current ambient values, and the current speed reading, and start a new pass.
